review_list.review_title: Samsung crystal view 55 is a great deal
review_list.review_text: The 55 crystal view is a excellent tv for the money the colors are amazing the blacks are incredible the menu is really easy to use and the remote is very intuitive you learn the buttons immediately tv has great sound and a lot of bass for factory speakers all and all this tv is worth every penny spent
Samsung always has the best picture quality, and for the price you can't beat it. I used this TV in a give away and the winner absolutely lived it. Would recommend 10/10.
This smart tv is very good even I love the service from the store even I recommend to my friends go to the Best Buy and grab the good deals
Best purchase I could've done, great tv with great picture and sound.

This TV is perfect for a young adult's mid-size bedroom. It has good brightness levels and good built-in sound for being mounted on the wall. I would spend more for an upgraded model for a living room or larger bedroom, however.

The picture quality of this tv is so nice! The sound and brightness are great too, My only complaint, and a friend did warn me about this and I should have listened, but the TV itself is slow. The main menu and UI of the TV is actually so insanely slow. Thankfully since I use an Apple TV, I only have to deal with it for the few seconds it takes to select the input I need. If not for that, I would have probably picked a different tv. But if you use your own external source for streaming apps, the picture quality of the tv is worth the hassle of the slow UI.

This TV combines an outstanding balance of crisp picture quality with user-friendly smart features, and value. I chose this TV for one of my vacation rentals, and it has exceeded my expectations with its dependable performance and lasting quality.

Bought as a bedroom TV so no concerns about viewing angle or room brightness. TV has great picture and sound quality. Like most TVs now, screen works more like a computer but I'm getting used to that.  Attached a swivel mount we had from a prior Samsung, fit perfectly. New remote is too simple for my taste, I prefer numbers and such; fortunately, Samsung remotes will work with all models of Samsung TVs (in my experience anyway, and we've had a few over the years) so using the older one with no issues.  Very pleased.
Good product, love clarity of screen easy to control functions. Very satisfyied with quality and the price for tv

Only issue my wife has a hard time with the remote and you turn off it does not open in the app you left off atso you have to reset. No ports for the stereo aka RCA or Digital Not really a problem, did have it on the old TV did not use a lot Nice when needed.

We switched from an old Vizio tv to this one. It’s not as easy to maneuver around the apps page as the Vizio. I had to set up a Samsung account to use this TV which bugs me. The picture is fine, not outstanding but better than the old TV. I thought about returning it but wasn’t worth the hassle.

Was happy about find this on sale. Was bigger then I was intending to get but around what I wanted to spend. It all worked out. Picture is crystal clear. Able to sign into streaming service.  Have never been unhappy with Samsung products yet ::knocks on wood::

The Samsung 55" Class U8000H Series Crystal UHD 4K Smart Tizen TV offers great picture quality with sharp 4K resolution and vibrant colors. The setup is simple, the Tizen interface is easy to use, and streaming apps run smoothly. It's an excellent value and a great choice for everyday movies, TV shows, and sports.
It can be slow when navigating smart tv features, but otherwise its been great. It was worth the price i paid for it .
Amazing picture, many apps available.  Littl difficult finding apps and saving icon for apps. Well worth the effort
We bought this brand different model previously before and had a good use out of it for a long time. Price is decent, size is good, quality is great.. def. Recommended

Purchased this TV 2 months ago. Very satisfied with my purchase. Great quality, sound, picture and color. Tons of free movies and channels. You can easily operate the Samsung TVs from your cell phone. This is my 3rd Samsung and it’s the only brand of TVs that I will purchase. The price was great and it was ready for pick up within an hour. I own two other Samsungs.  One I’ve had for 10 years and the other I’ve had for 6 years.
Great picture ,easy to setup. Compared to a few other brands, extremely happy with my choice. Great VALUE!
Quality is great and is a lot bigger than I thought it would be. Colors are nice and the blacks or okay.

questions.summary: This 55 inch smart television delivers high dynamic range content with a 60Hz refresh rate. It includes pre-installed streaming apps and a built-in app store. Connectivity options include Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, and multiple HDMI ports for external devices. The television supports voice commands via compatible external devices and features screen mirroring. It is designed for wall mounting with a 200x200mm VESA pattern. The unit includes a remote and a 1-year warranty for parts and labor.

answers.text:

questions.question: Does this TV offer pitcher in pitcher? If not, what models do carry picture and picture?

answers.text:
Hi Jj,

The U8000H does not feature Picture-in-Picture. Multi View is available on the M80H Mini LED and higher and lets you watch two sources at once – TV on one side, your phone on the other. Play HDMI, apps, or cable on the left, and mirror or cast your phone on the right. Two HDMI inputs can’t be used at the same time.

~ Samsung Advisor

How do I download an app to this TV?

answers.text:
Hi Greg,

To add new apps to your U8000H: 

1.	From the Home screen, press up on the remote’s directional pad. 
2.	Navigate to and select Search.
3.	Using the search bar, enter the content or app you’d like to find.
4.	Navigate to and select the app you’d like to install, then select Install.

Note: Previously installed apps can be accessed on the Settings screen.

Adding & Managing Apps on Home Screen
1.	Go to App Settings (these can be found at the bottom of the Apps screen) and select the app you want to move. The following options will be available:
a.	Add to Home: Move the app to your desired location on the Home screen.
b.	Delete: Delete app.
c.	Lock/Unlock: Lock the app with a PIN so only you can use it. When the app is selected again, you will be prompted to enter the PIN to unlock it.
d.	Reinstall: Reinstall the app.
e.	View Details: View the app’s information and details.

I hope this helps!

~Samsung Advisor

questions.question: The stand width is listed at 32”. Is that measured from the inside or outside of the stand legs?

answers.text:
Hi Ddhe,

The 55" U8000H TV stand feet are 32" apart, and this measurement is taken from the outside of the feet.

~Samsung Advisor

questions.question: Will other people in the room be able to hear the TV if I use my Bluetooth headphones?

answers.text:
Hi Bob,

You sure can connect your AirPods or wireless headset via Bluetooth. You can also use the Multi-output Audio feature to use both TV speakers and Bluetooth headsets simultaneously if you have viewers who want two different volume levels.  

~Samsung Advisor

questions.question: Can this Tv work in portrait mode or Atleast have the option for screen/display rotation?

answers.text:
Hi,

No, the U8000H cannot be rotated. 

~Samsung Advisor

html_renders.html: Watch all your content in crisp 4K resolution, with rich contrast, amazing color and clear picture. Discover thousands of subscription-free channels, including 700+ premium channels with Samsung TV Plus. Also, play thousands of video games without a console thanks to Samsung Gaming Hub. Enjoy peace of mind for years to come with the TV brand rated #1 in durability.

Crystal Processor 4K

Immerse yourself in lifelike visuals. See every shade of color as the creators intended in brilliant 4K resolution, and experience sharper details with powerful 4K upscaling. From thrilling sports to cinematic movies, vibrant games and gripping TV shows, everything you watch is transformed into stunning clarity and vivid color that brings every detail to life.

Endless Free Content

Dive into endless entertainment with 2,700+ free streaming options, including 750+ subscription-free channels on Samsung TV Plus — all with just an internet connection. Stay updated with live news, enjoy blockbuster movies or explore kids' shows and international hits. With thousands of on-demand movies and fresh content added regularly, there’s always something new to watch. Free, convenient and packed with variety, it's entertainment for every occasion.¹

Motion Xcelerator

Stay in the action with smooth motion clarity in your favorite games and sports. By intelligently analyzing and optimizing frame transitions, this technology ensures fluid visuals and crisp detail at up to 4K 60Hz. Whether you’re gaming in fast-paced action or watching a thrilling match, see every move and play clearly, so you don't miss a moment.

Color Booster

Every scene comes to life, from fiery reds and oranges to cool blues and greens. With Color Booster, all colors are enhanced, ensuring your favorite content is vivid and beautiful. Transform your viewing experience with rich hues and vibrancy.

4K Upscaling

Transform your viewing experience on all your favorite content. Whether it's classic films, new movies, or binge-worthy shows, our upscaling technology delivers incredible clarity and detail to every scene. Even content from lower-quality sources is enhanced to reveal hidden details you’ve never seen before.

Gaming Hub

Transform your TV into a gaming destination with Gaming Hub. Access your favorite titles from consoles, cloud services and gaming apps— all in one place, no console required. With personalized recommendations, discover hidden gems or revisit fan favorites. Whether you’re exploring new worlds, playing online with friends, or trying out a new cloud game, Gaming Hub makes it easy to jump right in with seamless access and hassle-free navigation.²

DLG 120Hz

Experience smoother motion and sharper details with DLG 120Hz.³ This technology increases your TV refresh rate up to 120 Hz, offering responsive performance with reduced lag.

Object Tracking Sound Lite

Experience sound that moves with the action on screen. Featuring a virtual top channel, sound is placed precisely in space and moves with the scene, creating a sense of immersion. Whether it's high-speed car chases, intense shootouts or soft-spoken dialogue, enjoy dynamic, clear audio that enhances every moment. Perfect for bringing every detail to life in your favorite shows and movies.

Soccer Mode

Bring the excitement of the stadium into your living room with optimized settings for brightness, contrast, and motion. You’ll see every pass, shot, and goal in stunning detail with 40% better motion clarity and 30% more vibrant colors. Specifically designed for soccer, it enhances motion clarity to effectively track fast kicks and provides richer greens⁴ for an authentic pitch look. As a result, crowd details and player movements appear sharper than ever.

Samsung Knox Security

Your TV experiences are secured. Samsung Knox Security protects you from harmful attacks by automatically blocking unauthorized apps and phishing websites. It also safeguards your IoT devices connected to your TV, plus your sensitive information, including your PIN codes and passwords. With regular updates, your TV is always kept safe.⁵
